svg.title: A recruiter at the terminal
svg.desc: $ sudo hire ashfak / [sudo] password for recruiter: ******** / access granted / offer letter queued · exactly-once delivery · idempotency key: you / $ # two recruiters, one interview slot, the same millisecond / $ book "Mon 10:00" & book "Mon 10:00" / [1] 201 Created interview confirmed: Mon 10:00 / [2] 409 Conflict ashfak is already booked. next free slot: Mon 11:00 / $
